name: Slaughter Servitor (Excoriator)

bonuses.name: Iron Soul
bonuses.text: This Threat is unaffected by Abilities that target the mind, and never needs to make a Resolve Test to continue fighting.

abilities.name: Horrifying Flaying
abilities.text: If this Threat rolls a Wrath Critical as part of an attack with its blade arms, the target increases the Bleeding Condition to 2.

abilities.name: Dulled Blades
abilities.text: The Slaughter Servitor reduces its blade arms attack damage to 9 + 1 ED for 1 Round.

note: No Tier row printed; class proposed (5 Wounds, no Champion bonus, a rank-and-file servitor above a Troop). Blade Arms trait prints 'Inflict (Bleeding [1])'; stored in the catalogue's spelling. Printed as the third block of the Slaughter Servitor entry that starts on p.55.
